content: Řmewt d wenḍeř n Sara
Tuɣa ɣar Sara mya u-sebɛa u-ɛicrin n iseggʷusa. Man aya d řmijař n iseggʷusa n tudart n Sara.
Uca temmut Sara di Qaryat-Arbaɛ, ixs ad yini Ḥabrun, di temmurt n Kenɛan. Uca yudef-dd Ibrahim ɣar uqiḍun, icḍen x Sara, isɣuy xas.
Xas uca ikkar Ibrahim ṭṭarf i umettin nnes, uca issiweř ak-d tarwa n Ḥit, inna:
“Necc d abarrani d amɛezzeb ɣar awem. Wcem ayi mɣir anḍeř d agřa jar awem, ḥima ad neḍřeɣ amettin inu zi zzat inu.”
Arrin-dd tarwa n Ḥit x Ibrahim, nnan as:
“Seř ɣarneɣ, a sidi inu! Cek d řḥakem n AREBBI jar aneɣ. Nḍeř amettin nnec deg wenḍeř nneɣ iṣebḥen. Uřa d ijj zzayneɣ ad cek iṭṭef x wenḍeř nnes, ḥima ad dayes tneḍřed amettin nnec.”
Xenni ikkar Ibrahim, ibendeq zzat i řgens n temmurt, zzat i tarwa n Ḥit
uca issiweř akidsen, inna: “Mařa kenniw s array nwem ad neḍřeɣ amettin inu zi zzat inu, sřem ɣari uca zawgem di ṭṭweɛ inu ɣar Ɛifrun, mmis n Zuhar,
maḥend ad ayi iwc ifri n Makfila, d wenni nnes, ɣar ṭṭarf n yeyyar nnes. Ejj i-t ad ayi t iwc s ttaman nnes ikmeř. Ad yiři d anḍeř inu i ɣa mellkeɣ jar awem.”
Ɛifrun tuɣa iqqim jar tarwa n Ḥit uca Ɛifrun, Aḥitti, yarra-dd x Ibrahim deg imejjan n tarwa n Ḥit d marra inni yudfen ɣar tewwart n tendint nnes, inna:
“Lla, a sidi inu, seř-dd ɣari! Necc ad ac wceɣ iyyar uřa d ifri nni dayes iǧan. Zzat i tiṭṭawin n tarwa n řgens inu ad ac t wceɣ, nḍeř amettin nnec!”
Xenni ibendeq Ibrahim s uɣembub nnes ɣar temmurt zzat i řgens n temmurt
uca issiweř ak-d Ɛifrun deg imezzuɣen n řgens n temmurt, inna: “Ttzawgeɣ, mařa texsed, seř-dd ɣari. Ad ac wceɣ nnuqart n yeyyar, qbeř i-tt zzayi, xenni ad dayes neḍřeɣ amettin inu.”
Yarra-dd Ɛifrun x Ibrahim, inna as:
“Sidi inu, seř-dd ɣari! Min ixs ad yini iyyar isekkwan arebɛa-mya ciqlu n nnuqart jar ayi d cek? Nḍeř amettin nnec!”
Isřa Ibrahim i Ɛifrun uca iwzen Ibrahim i Ɛifrun tmenyat n nnuqart i xef issiweř deg imezzuɣen n tarwa n Ḥit: arebɛa-mya ciqlu n nnuqart, am tt nnumen isebbaben.
Ammu i idweř yeyyar n Ɛifrun, wenni iǧan di Makfila arendad n Mamri, iyyar d ifri wenni dayes iǧan d marra ticejjura inni deg iyyar ɣar iymiren nnes i d as dd-innḍen,
d agřa n Ibrahim zzat i tarwa n Ḥit d marra inni yudfen ɣar tewwart n tendint.
Awarni aya inḍeř Ibrahim Sara, tamɣart nnes, deg ifri n yeyyar n Makfila qibač i Mamri, wenni iǧan d Ḥabrun di temmurt n Kenɛan.
Ammu i idweř iyyar ak-d yefri i dayes iǧan zi tarwa n Ḥit ɣar Ibrahim am wenḍeř nnes.

footnotes.text: aciql ... iciqlen- ijj n řeqyas n wureɣ d nnuqart u n řḥajat nneɣni. Aqa din uřa d aciql n Zzawect Iqeddsen (xzar Uf. 38:26).
Makfila- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘tnayen n tseqqar’ niɣ ‘tasɣart’ (x webrid n umedya: ‘tasɣart n temmurt’).
